newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali in bank cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali in bank cooperation deal.

text.p: Austro-Italian insurer EA-Generali and a group of three regional Austrian banks said on Wednesday they had agreed a long-term insurance cooperation agreement.

Under the terms of the deal EA-Generali would take a 15 percent voting stake in Bank fuer Tirol und Vorarlberg (BTV) and an eight percent voting stake in Bank fuer Kaernten und Steiermark (BKS), the group said in a statement.
"Indirectly that will also give EA-Generali an involvement in Bank fuer Oberoesterreich und Salzburg (Oberbank)," the statement said.

EA-Generali already operates an insurance joint venture with Creditanstalt-Bankverein. Both sides have said Creditanstalt's takeover in January by market leader Bank Austria will not affect the business.
EA-Generali was part of an international consortium that lost out in the race for control of Creditanstalt.

"This deal will secure the independence of the three-bank group while increasing the range of products offered to their customers. For EA-Generali the agreement creates an additional marketing route for its insurance," the statement said.
A steering committee would explore ways of guaranteeing a successful cooperation in insurance and also real estate, it continued.
